stemMd: The function $f(x)=(x-6)/4$ is one-to-one. Which formula gives its inverse?
explanationMd: Set y=(x−6)/4 and solve for x: x=4y+6. Interchanging variable names gives the inverse formula 4x+6.

distractorRationale.b: A reciprocal is not generally an inverse function.
distractorRationale.a: This does not undo division by four.
